title: External clients
help: Connections share only this notebook and snapshot. Keep Zotero open. Revoking a connection blocks new requests; excerpts already received remain with the client.
label: Connection name
setupHelp: These examples contain only the executable and private connection-file paths. Review and add the entry manually; existing configuration is never overwritten. The file itself contains the limited credential: do not share its contents. Use a separate connection for each client.
matrix: External extraction proposals appear in the matrix for human review. They never overwrite an approved cell.
